camera_fps.description: Camera capture rate in frames per second.

camera_inverted.description: True when the camera is mounted upside-down; applies a 180 degree rotation so a sign passes on the side the robot expects.

camera_rotation.description: Extra rotation in degrees applied on top of camera_inverted.

camera_hflip.description: Mirror the image horizontally; note this alone also swaps left and right in detections.

camera_vflip.description: Mirror the image vertically; prefer camera_inverted for an upside-down mount.

camera_af_mode.description: Autofocus mode; "manual" parks the lens at camera_lens_position, the other two let it hunt. "manual" | "auto" | "continuous"

camera_lens_position.description: Lens focus in dioptres (1/distance_m); required when af_mode is manual. Higher dioptres focus nearer.

camera_ae_exposure_mode.description: "normal" | "short" | "long" -- venue is well-lit, bias toward less motion blur

camera_analogue_gain.description: camera_exposure_time_us = 8000       # set together with camera_analogue_gain to disable AE entirely

camera_sharpness.description: libcamera sharpness multiplier; 1.0 is the sensor default.
